description: Pitch//break: The Survival Arena: Build under pressure. Pitch with conviction. Adapt to survive. Step into PITCH//BREAK , a four-round innovation challenge where a strong idea is only the beginning. Your ability to think fast, navigate unexpected twists, and defend your decisions will determine how far you go. Compete for a prize pool worth ₹50,000 and exclusive internship opportunities while putting your creativity, strategy, and resilience to the test. The Challenge: You begin with 100 Survival Points . Across four intense rounds, every solution, pitch, and decision shapes your journey through the arena. Round 1: Enter the Arena The clock starts ticking. Tackle a problem within a limited time and turn your ideas into a compelling solution. Quick thinking and clear priorities are your first survival tools. Round 2: Power Play Take your solution to the judges. Deliver a persuasive pitch to earn Power Cards or Wild Cards that could give you a strategic edge in the rounds ahead. Round 3: Break & Adapt Expect the unexpected. Face a surprise crisis that challenges your original approach. Rethink, adapt, and keep your solution viable under changing conditions. Round 4: Judge Attack Every decision is up for scrutiny. Defend your choices, explain your trade-offs, and demonstrate why your solution deserves to win. Who Will Survive? Victory goes to those who maximize their Survival Points through creativity, sound decisions, and adaptability. Whether you’re a first-time participant or an experienced innovator, prepare to have your ideas challenged and your resilience tested. Ready to enter the arena? Register now for PITCH//BREAK and prove your idea can survive the pressure.
organiser: University School of Automation & Robotics (USAR), GGSIPU EDC

Pitch//break: The Survival Arena:

Build under pressure. Pitch with conviction. Adapt to survive.

Step into PITCH//BREAK, a four-round innovation challenge where a strong idea is only the beginning. Your ability to think fast, navigate unexpected twists, and defend your decisions will determine how far you go.

Compete for a prize pool worth ₹50,000 and exclusive internship opportunities while putting your creativity, strategy, and resilience to the test.

The Challenge:

You begin with 100 Survival Points. Across four intense rounds, every solution, pitch, and decision shapes your journey through the arena.

Round 1: Enter the Arena

  • The clock starts ticking. Tackle a problem within a limited time and turn your ideas into a compelling solution. Quick thinking and clear priorities are your first survival tools.

Round 2: Power Play

  • Take your solution to the judges. Deliver a persuasive pitch to earn Power Cards or Wild Cards that could give you a strategic edge in the rounds ahead.

Round 3: Break & Adapt

  • Expect the unexpected. Face a surprise crisis that challenges your original approach. Rethink, adapt, and keep your solution viable under changing conditions.

Round 4: Judge Attack

  • Every decision is up for scrutiny. Defend your choices, explain your trade-offs, and demonstrate why your solution deserves to win.

Who Will Survive?

Victory goes to those who maximize their Survival Points through creativity, sound decisions, and adaptability. Whether you’re a first-time participant or an experienced innovator, prepare to have your ideas challenged and your resilience tested.

Ready to enter the arena? Register now for PITCH//BREAK and prove your idea can survive the pressure.
